system.description:
A hill-den brute with a grip that's cracked stone and a temper to match. Grigsdotter doesn't bargain in riddles like the others; she bargains in favours owed and debts collected, and she always collects.

  • Recipe (1st): Hex Oil.
  • Patron Curse (3rd): Once per day, when a creature fails its save against your Hex, the Hex deals an extra 2d6 damage the first time it harms that creature (4d6 from 13th). This needs no action.
  • Physical Change (7th): Your nails thicken into short, blackened claws, and you have Advantage on Strength checks to break or force objects. Your claw deals an extra 1d6 damage to a creature under your Hex.
